premise.claim: The Helm chart shipped the pre-gate webhook configuration, so Helm installs had no v1alpha1 deprecation warning plane (and no Exact-match v1alpha1 enforcement entries) even though #524 merged the handlers and the kubectl-rendered config/webhook/manifests.yaml.
premise.evidence: results/premise-base-chart.out — base chart render: v1alpha1 InstanceSet write admitted with NO deprecation warning; v1alpha1 RBG new deprecated use still rejected via the Equivalent-matching v1alpha2 gate but with NO warning. Reproduce: bash scripts/run-premise-base.sh

integration.cmd: KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS="$([ -x ./bin/setup-envtest ] && ./bin/setup-envtest use 1.31.0 --bin-dir ./bin -p path 2>/dev/null || echo ./bin/k8s/1.31.0-linux-amd64)" go test ./test/envtest/testcase/deprecationv1a1helm/ -count=1 -json

findings.note: The rendered chart's six v1alpha1 deprecation webhook entries match config/webhook/manifests.yaml (name/path/rules/failurePolicy/matchPolicy/sideEffects/admissionReviewVersions). Also covers the PR's F12-adjacent toggle tests already in test/chart.

findings.notes: envtest installs the CHART-RENDERED webhook configurations against production handlers: new-use rejection (explicit and schema-defaulted), type-exact grandfathering of a seeded pre-gate object, per-kind on-the-wire warnings for all four warning-only paths, Exact match policy (no v1alpha2 warnings), ungated deletes.
